description: Native printer output for generated names, emit helpers and the parentheses parenthesizeExpressionForNoAsi creates. Each case parses `source` as /main.ts, rewrites marker identifiers with the emit context's node visitor ($temp, $loop, $affixed, $unique_<n>, $optimistic_<n>, $filelevel_<n>, $helper_<n>, $node_<n>, $strtemp, $strunique_<n>, #unique_<n>; functions named reuse* get ReuseTempVariableScope; `pee` turns parenthesized expressions into partially emitted ones), records the helpers and flags, and prints the file `writes` times with one printer.
producer: tools/phase3/printer_witness/a1_witness_test.go, overlaid into tsc/internal/printer and run as TestA1Witness
